info.description: The Support Tickets Feedback API allows users to access feedback associated with support tickets. It provides a means to retrieve valuable insights from customer interactions, helping organizations to improve their service quality. This endpoint typically serves customer support teams, product managers, and quality assurance personnel seeking to analyze user feedback. By leveraging this API, developers can build applications that enhance support processes and optimize user satisfaction.
